integrity: The proof is analytic: the ROS2 rational stability function is differentiated in closed form, then evaluated exactly on a nilpotent Jordan shift. The packaged checker replays threshold identities and exact sign witnesses but does not replace the universal argument.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for the serial Metzler family J_n=-I+N_n, the larger L-stable ROS2 parameter, exact Jacobians, and completed-step positivity. It does not classify arbitrary Metzler matrices, nonlinear reaction networks, W-method Jacobian approximations, internal-stage positivity, or other Rosenbrock schemes.
title: Exact state-count positivity law for ROS2 on serial decay chains
